message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of **Canadian federal holidays** that created *at least one* “extra” day around a weekend in 2023—i.e., holidays that fell on a **Friday** or a **Monday** (or were officially observed on the following Monday when the actual holiday landed on a weekend).  
These are the dates most planners refer to when looking for “long weekends.”

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Falls On | Creates Long Weekend |
|---|---------|-------------|----------|----------------------|
| 1 | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, PEI, NB, NL, QC) | Mon Feb 20 | Monday | ✔️ (Sat Feb 18–Mon Feb 20) |
| 2 | Good Friday | Fri Apr 07 | Friday | ✔️ (Thu Apr 06–Sun Apr 09) |
| 3 | Easter Monday | Mon Apr 10 | Monday | ✔️ (Sat Apr 08–Mon Apr 10) |
| 4 | Victoria Day | Mon May 22 | Monday | ✔️ (Sat May 20–Mon May 22) |
| 5 | Labour Day | Mon Sep 04 | Monday | ✔️ (Sat Sep 02–Mon Sep 04) |
| 6 | Thanksgiving | Mon Oct 09 | Monday | ✔️ (Sat Oct 07–Mon Oct 09) |
| 7 | Remembrance Day (observed) | Fri Nov 10 | Friday | ✔️ (Thu Nov 09–Sun Nov 12) |
| 8 | Christmas Day | Mon Dec 25 | Monday | ✔️ (Sat Dec 23–Mon Dec 25) |

> **Note:**  
> • Canada Day (Jul 01) fell on a Saturday, so it didn’t add an extra day to a weekend.  
> • Boxing Day (Dec 26) fell on a Tuesday; while it does give a two‑day break, it isn’t usually called a “long weekend.”  

---

### Quick Integration Snippet (JavaScript)

If your holiday‑planning app pulls events from an external source, here’s how you could embed the above list directly:

```js
const canadianLongWeekends_2023 = [
  {name:"Family Day",   date:new Date("2023-02-20")},
  {name:"Good Friday",  date:new Date("2023-04-07")},
  {name:"Easter Monday",date:new Date("2023-04-10")},
  {name:"Victoria Day", date:new Date("2023-05-22")},
  {name:"Labour Day",   date:new Date("2023-09-04")},
  {name:"Thanksgiving", date:new Date("2023-10-09")},
  {name:"Remembrance Day", date:new Date("2023-11-10")}, // observed
  {name:"Christmas Day", date:new Date("2023-12-25")}
];
```

Add these objects to whatever calendar component you’re using, and label them “Long Weekend” or similar. Feel free to adjust the `Date` constructor based on your locale/timezone handling logic.

Happy trip planning!
